title: Invariant Reduction for Partial Differential Equations. IV: Symmetries that Rescale Geometric Structures
summary: For a system of partial differential equations admitting point, contact, or higher symmetries, the framework of invariant reduction systematically computes how invariant geometric structures, such as conservation laws, presymplectic structures, variational principles, and Poisson brackets, are inherited by the systems governing symmetry-invariant solutions. We extend this mechanism to geometric structures that are not invariant but are $\textit{rescaled}$ by a symmetry.
